name: sportup
description: SportUp — Discover, Create & Join Sporting Activities

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run shared:build && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/mobile
scripts.test: npm run shared:build && tsx --test packages/shared/src/utils/activityMath.test.ts && tsx --test packages/shared/src/utils/segmentMatching.test.ts && tsx --test apps/api/src/modules/runs/run.routes.test.ts && tsx --test apps/api/src/modules/analytics/analytics.routes.test.ts && tsx --test apps/api/src/modules/clubs/club.routes.test.ts
scripts.build:android: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.build:android:prod: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production
